content: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), including liraglutide and semaglutide, have been linked to an elevated risk of exacerbating diabetic retinopathy in certain clinical studies. It is essential to closely monitor the progression of diabetic retinopathy in patients undergoing treatment with GLP-1 RAs, particularly in those who already have pre-existing diabetic retinopathy. Additionally, individuals who experience rapid reductions in hemoglobin A1C levels while on these medications may also require heightened surveillance for potential retinopathy progression.
